title: UHRF1 is a mediator of KRAS driven oncogenesis in lung adenocarcinoma
model: KRAS-mutant A549-Cas9 lung cancer cells, minipool of 483 sgRNAs (80 tumour-suppressor genes, 12 positive controls, 26 safe controls)
contrast: T1 (day 18) vs T0 depletion, separately in sgNeg and sgUHRF1 backgrounds (2 vs 2 each)
paper_calls: sgNeg: 37 genes at FDR 0.10; sgUHRF1: 16 (PTEN and TSC1 top enriched in both)
barcs_calls: sgNeg: 66 genes at FDR 0.10 (58 enriched); sgUHRF1: 5 (4 enriched); only 26 safe controls, below the threshold for a control null or calibration
named_hits: PTEN (#1), TSC1 (#2), MAP3K4 (#3), MAP2K4 (#10) all enriched at FDR 0.10 in the sgNeg background; TSC1 (#1) and PTEN (FDR 0.11) top the sgUHRF1 background
verdict: BARCS reproduces the minipool TSG screen almost exactly in both backgrounds (rank correlation 0.96 sgNeg, 0.90 sgUHRF1; PTEN/TSC1/MAP3K4 the top enriched knockouts), calling a somewhat longer list than the authors' z-score cutoff.
